claim.text: redact_and_save / redact_and_save_with / redact_and_save_opts with the default StructureTreePolicy::Strip: when at least one region is flattened, the strip UNLINKS only (lead diagnosis DIAG-PRESS-R27): it removes the catalog's /StructTreeRoot and /MarkInfo, every /StructParents, /StructParent and /SE entry of every dictionary and the /SD of every GoTo action (/S the name GoTo), and deletes no object. The save writes only the objects reachable from the trailer /Root and /Info (writer::write_document over writer::reachable), so structure-tree objects that only these entries reached are not in the saved file. An object anything kept still reaches (an /AcroForm, an annotation, an optional-content group, an action, an outline item, a private catalog key, an object stream or alias kept as such) stays unchanged, structure-shaped or not; structure that stays is reported by check_document (region_flattened false, NotProven::ResidualInRegion), which also reads a dictionary holding /ParentTree /IDTree /ClassMap /RoleMap or /ParentTreeNextKey as structure. RedactedOutput::losses is [AccessibilityTagsRemoved] only when a structure entry was unlinked from an object the saved file holds and its value resolves: the catalog's /StructTreeRoot resolving to a dictionary with /Type StructTreeRoot, or without /Type holding /K or a root key; or a /StructParents, /StructParent, /SE or /SD whose value is not null (a reference to no object reads as null). Not for /MarkInfo alone (R26-S4), not for a /StructTreeRoot naming no object or a non-root dictionary (R27-S3). A tagged document whose tree only those entries reached reads region_flattened / region_cleared / is_proven. Content streams are unchanged (marked-content operators with /MCID stay). StructureTreePolicy::KeepNotProven keeps the pre-D28 behaviour. A save with no region strips nothing.
